messages:
lauren: Heads up — model `gpt-mini-ckpt` failed our chat_template evals after HF->Redwood conversion. Diff shows special tokens shifted (eos/pad/endoftext ids not aligned).

diego: oof. any reproduce steps?

lauren: repro is simple: convert with `hf-to-redwood --model gpt-mini-ckpt` then run `eval/chat_template_suite`. BLEU dropped ~0.5% and a lot of responses truncated mid-sentence.

mira: truncation usually = eos token id mismatch. Did the HF checkpoint have both `tokenizer.json` and `tokenizer_config.json`?

lauren: only `tokenizer.json` in the artifact. no `tokenizer_config.json` — but the fast tokenizer wrote a `tokenizer.json` that disagrees with the repo's `special_tokens_map.json` (there's an extra `` added in the fast file).

diego: that explains it. fast tokenizer merges specials differently. we should detect when `tokenizer.json` exists but `tokenizer_config.json` is missing and run a merge/heuristic.

jon: +1. Also watch for `added_tokens.json` and `special_tokens_map.json` being present separately — slow vs fast produce different subsets.

lauren: quick workaround: when converting, if `tokenizer_config.json` missing, prefer the slow/legacy mapping if available or fallback to merging using `special_tokens_map.json`. here's a tiny merge we ran locally:

```
python - <<'PY'
import json
try:
    t=json.load(open('tokenizer.json'))
except FileNotFoundError:
    t={}
sm={}
try:
    sm=json.load(open('special_tokens_map.json'))
except FileNotFoundError:
    pass
# prefer existing mapping keys
t.setdefault('special_tokens_map', {}).update(sm)
json.dump(t, open('tokenizer_merged.json','w'), indent=2)
print('wrote tokenizer_merged.json')
PY
```

mira: nice. can we add a unit check in onboarding: after conversion, ensure that special token string -> id mapping matches a golden reference (if provided) or at least that `pad`, `eos`, `bos` exist and ids are distinct?

diego: yes. I'll add a preflight that fails conversion with a clear message if those checks don't pass. quick jq to find other artifacts missing `tokenizer_config.json`:

```
jq -r '.models[] | select(.files | (has("tokenizer_config.json") | not)) | .id' registry_index.json
```

lauren: can you run that job across the staging model mirror and drop results in #eng-ml? I suspect 4–5 more models.

sre-bot: scan scheduled by @diego — job id `scan-2024-03-23-01` queued.

jon: edge case — some HF uploads intentionally only include `tokenizer.json` (fast) and rely on `tokenizer_config.json` being implicit. merging can still be lossy: the fast file sometimes reassigns unk token id. We should add a regression test comparing token->string roundtrip on a small prompt set.

lauren: good call. i'll add two quick evals: 1) roundtrip tokens on 200 prompts; 2) chat_template sanity that checks outputs aren't truncated and eos appears only at the end.

mira: add a metric that flags any shift in special token ids vs prior model version > 0.

diego: picking this up. plan: (a) run the jq scan, (b) run merge heuristic for artifacts missing `tokenizer_config.json`, (c) run the token-id sanity checks, (d) produce a short report with models that need manual inspection.

lauren: thanks. can you add a small logging line in the conversion CLI so the converter prints which source it relied on (`tokenizer.json` vs `tokenizer_config.json` vs `special_tokens_map.json`) so we can triage faster?

diego: will do. PR coming from me later today. linking the stub here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/XXXX

lauren: awesome. leaving a note to @mira to audit any downstream quantization experiments for the flagged models — token ID shifts can silently change quant behavior.

mira: on it. i'll run a quick quant sanity on the flagged list and post results.

lauren: perf/quality note for the ticket: the one broken model had approx 0.4% end-of-sentence token leakage during convo evals which caused the UI to cut responses. small but user visible.

sre-bot: job `scan-2024-03-23-01` started.

diego: filing a tiny onboarding patch and the preflight checks. thanks all :thumbsup:

lauren: thanks — keeping this thread to track the conversion heuristics/scan results. if we find more weirdness we'll escalate to model-onboarding weekly sync.
